mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Conditions are clear near the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 60 degrees and a First Quarter moon lighting up the sky, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight.

The city reminds residents that the VHAT cable channel is your go-to for government meetings and community news. Also, remember that residential parking rules require vehicles to be parked on approved surfaces at least 5 feet from property lines.
There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch Concerts in the Park tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly service report, on July 15, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Oaks Drive, resulting in one arrest for felony bail jumping.
Today's flavor is the classic Turtle. Since the shop is currently closed, plan your visit for when they open at 10:30 AM to enjoy your treat.
